fields.System.Title: INB-402 — Put received stock on quality hold
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a quality inspector, I want to hold stock from a receipt or a batch, so that
suspect goods stop being sellable while I inspect them.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a hold scope — receipt, batch, product, or location — then all matching stock
  • moves to quarantine status.
  • - Given stock in scope with existing reservations, then those reservations are released
  • and the affected orders flagged, in the same transaction.
  • - Given stock in scope already picked or packed, then it is flagged for physical
  • interception.
  • - Given the hold, then it is retroactive — it catches stock received before the hold was
  • created.
  • - Given release, then it requires an inspection record — see
  • [INV-402](../INV/INV-402-release-from-quarantine.md).

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, inventory, outbound |
| Tables | quality_hold, stock_balance, reservation |
| Risks | Hold missing allocated or picked stock ([doc 09 §8.5](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration (stock in every state) · rollback |
